name: localalot
description: Original Copilot inline completions and next edits with local model endpoints.

commands.title: Toggle Localalot Inline Suggestions for Current Language

localalot.enable.description: Enable inline completions by language ID. Individual languages override the * fallback.

localalot.exclude.description: Glob patterns for files where inline completion and next edit suggestions are disabled.

localalot.ignoreWhenSuggestVisible.description: Temporarily hide AI inline suggestions while the regular IntelliSense suggestion list is visible.

localalot.respectSelectedCompletionInfo.description: Build ghost completions from the selected IntelliSense item while its list is open. Defaults to on only when editor quick suggestions are disabled.

localalot.ghost.speculativePrefetch.description: Fallback Ghost provider only. The original Copilot provider manages its own speculative requests.

localalot.nes.speculativePrefetch.description: Fallback NES provider only. The original provider needs VS Code's restricted suggestion lifecycle API for post-accept speculative requests.

localalot.wordPatterns.description: Per-language wordPattern additions (appended to the built-in pattern, not replacing it). Only languages with an explicit key (or the "*" fallback) are affected; other languages keep their native wordPattern. Keys are language IDs; "*" is a fallback for languages without an explicit key. Values are regex fragments, optionally wrapped as /fragment/flags (non-g flags like i/m/u are applied; the stateful g flag is stripped).

localalot.ghost.tokenizer.description: Tokenizer used by the original Ghost prompt builder to fit context within the local model window. Choose the tokenizer matching your model when available.

localalot.ghost.endpoint.description: Local model endpoint for Ghost inline completions. Supports OpenAI completions, FIM completions, chat completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages. Chat-style endpoints receive the original Copilot prefix, suffix, and context as code-insertion messages.

localalot.ghost.family.description: Model family for Ghost Responses requests. OpenAI reasoning families use reasoning effort instead of sampling overrides.

localalot.ghost.capabilities.supports.re.description: Reasoning effort for Ghost Responses requests with an OpenAI reasoning model family. Low keeps inline suggestions responsive.

localalot.ghost.contextPlacement.description: Where GHOST sends diagnostics, recent edits and related code. 'prefix' lets standard completion servers see this context; use 'extra' for a server that supports Copilot's extra.context field.

localalot.ghost.semanticContextEnabled.description: Include language-server definitions, imports, and cursor symbol facts in original Copilot inline completion prompts.

localalot.advanced.contextProviderTimeBu.description: Milliseconds allowed for original Copilot inline completion context providers. Higher values can improve cold language-server context at the cost of latency.

localalot.ghost.stops.description: Custom stop sequences for GHOST generation. Empty uses Copilot's language-specific defaults.

localalot.ghost.promptTemplate.description: FIM prompt template for the /completions endpoint. Use {prefix} and {suffix} placeholders.

localalot.ghost.capabilities.limits.max_.description: Maximum output tokens for GHOST requests
Local Ghost model context window in tokens. The original Copilot prompt builder reserves output tokens within this limit.

localalot.ghost.capabilities.limits.dela.description: Optional minimum interval (ms) between GHOST network requests; 0 uses Copilot-style request timing

localalot.ghost.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty for GHOST completions (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

localalot.ghost.frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty for GHOST completions (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

localalot.ghost.stream.description: Enable SSE streaming for GHOST completions

localalot.nes.promptingStrategy.description: Original Copilot NES prompt and response format. Select the strategy expected by the local model.

localalot.nes.includeTagsInCurrentFile.description: Include original NES structural tags in the current-file prompt, unless the selected strategy overrides this.

localalot.nes.includePostScript.description: Include the original NES instruction after the code context.

localalot.nes.lintOptions.description: Optional original NES lint context settings. An empty object disables lint context.

localalot.nes.diagnosticContextEnabled.description: Include nearby VS Code errors and warnings in the original NES context. Automatically skips this provider when lintOptions are configured.

localalot.nes.mimicGhostTextBehavior.description: Use the original NES model's ghost-text-like display behavior when available.

localalot.nextEditSuggestions.eagerness.description: How eagerly the original Copilot NES provider offers next edits. Also available in the bottom-right completion menu.

localalot.nextEditSuggestions.enabled.description: Enable original Copilot next edit suggestions for this language. Unified models can still provide inline completions when next edits are disabled.

localalot.nextEditSuggestions.extendedRa.description: Enable original Copilot predicted cursor jumps for this language. The bottom-right toggle remains a workspace fallback when no language override is set.

localalot.nextEditSuggestions.triggerOnE.description: Trigger the original NES workflow after switching editors within this many seconds of an edit. Set to null to disable editor-switch triggering.

localalot.nes.stream.description: Use SSE streaming for NES edits. Disable this for endpoints that only return a complete response.

localalot.nes.sendPrediction.description: Send the original Copilot predicted edit window to compatible chat/completions endpoints. Enable only if the model server supports the prediction request field.

localalot.nes.family.description: Model family for NES thinking mode

localalot.nes.capabilities.limits.max_ou.description: NES output cap. For smaller model windows, Localalot reduces this cap to leave room for the original prompt.

localalot.nes.promptTemplate.description: NES prompt template. Use {system} and {user} placeholders.

localalot.nes.capabilities.limits.max_co.description: Local NES model total context window in tokens. Smaller windows reduce the original NES context budget and output cap.

localalot.nes.allowWhitespaceOnlyChanges.description: Allow NES to suggest interior whitespace and line-wrapping changes. Leading or trailing whitespace-only changes are still ignored.

localalot.nes.allowImportChanges.description: Allow NES to suggest import statement edits. Disable to filter edits that add, remove, or change imports.

localalot.nes.suffixOverlapThreshold.description: Fallback NES provider only: duplicate-line trimming threshold. The original provider uses its own response parser.

localalot.nes.suffixOverlapType.description: Fallback NES provider only: fuzzy suffix overlap type when the threshold is below 1.

localalot.nes.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty for NES (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far.

localalot.nes.frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty for NES (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency.

localalot.nes.nextCursorPrediction.jumpW.description: Fallback NES provider only: show a standalone cursor jump without an edit. The original provider requires an edit before offering a jump.

localalot.nes.nextCursorPrediction.model.description: Model for the original next-cursor predictor. Empty uses localalot.nes.model.

localalot.nes.nextCursorPrediction.curre.description: Maximum tokens from the current file included in the original predicted-cursor prompt.

localalot.nes.semanticContextEnabled.description: Include language-server definitions, imports, and cursor symbol facts in original Copilot NES prompts.

localalot.nes.neighborFilesEnabled.description: Include relevant neighboring files in original Copilot NES prompts.

localalot.nes.diagnosticFixesEnabled.description: Offer original Copilot diagnostic fixes, including import and async fixes, as next edits.

scripts.package: npm run build:native && webpack --mode production --devtool hidden-source-map
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
